# adapter_id_cases.json

Verbatim copy of `conformance/fixtures/adapter_id_cases.json` from
**IHP-GmbH/chiplet-spec**, commit `41264bc` ("Export the adapter-id
accept/reject oracle as a fixture").

    sha256  0364a6f2a2da84f9651af8283b1c456638e6897d174d105f271ed46ddfb80eb1
    cases   14 accept, 25 reject

Do not edit this file here. It is the shared oracle every implementation of the
adapter-id contract runs (`adk_registry.validate_adapter_id`, the KiCad export
plugin, chiplets-project-manager, and this repo), so that the proposition
"rejects everything the schema rejects" is exercised against one set rather
than against each implementation's own idea of the rule. A case added locally
is a case the other implementations never see.

To add or change a case, change it upstream in chiplet-spec (where
`conformance/test_chiplet_schema.py` proves the file against the schema
itself), then re-copy and update the hash above.

`ChipletFormatTest.AdapterIdParityWithSpecOracle` asserts that hash, so an
in-place edit here fails the suite rather than quietly diverging.
